note: These are required acceptance cases, not claimed passes. Automated isolation evidence is separate.

cases.title: B04 direct landing styles
cases.expected: 1440直开B04及从Keyboard客户端进入；pair cards/内容栅格/内链间距一致，非APair连字

cases.title: Shared dialog route independence
cases.expected: 390/1440冷启动B04、Labeled、Practice各打开Share；相同面板尺寸/状态/焦点，无CSS串路由依赖

cases.title: Labeled overview and labels
cases.expected: 390下概览为紧凑条；C♯4/D♭4各完整不拆字符，内容不越界；88与61一致

cases.title: Print action hierarchy
cases.expected: 主Print使用项目primary且是主操作；More不与桌面组重复显示

cases.title: Hash-only entry
cases.expected: /keyboard-notes#note-trainer显示Practice开始，页面无自动声音

cases.title: Entry state restore
cases.expected: 有效v1恢复同seed；非法v1正常fallback；hashchange与back/forward进入正确模式

cases.title: Selected note survives resize
cases.expected: F3/A0/C7分享恢复，390↔1440、横竖屏后所选音仍在窗口且不改音

cases.title: Replay/reveal race
cases.expected: 答错后Replay中试Hint/Reveal；被禁用或有正确事务；延迟完成不能reveal→ready

cases.title: Old run cannot clear new run
cases.expected: 播放A→切C→立即播放C，旧A结束不影响C的busy/phase/guess gate

cases.title: Stop and hidden cancellation
cases.expected: chord1/gap/chord2阶段分别Stop/后台，旧事件不complete、不叠音

cases.title: Replay after reveal
cases.expected: reveal后重播仍是reveal，资料/分享不丢

cases.title: Whole-page spoiler gate
cases.expected: 扫描整页初始可见内容含页尾，不能出现明确答案；不是只扫两个div

cases.title: All explanatory disclosures
cases.expected: 打开任一答案说明→helpUsed；切pair关闭/重置；保留展开时不得算独立

cases.title: Assisted result copy
cases.expected: 用了Hint/说明后正确反馈不推断heard/独立技能；general ability说明保留

cases.title: Stale manual share link
cases.expected: A复制失败→关面板→换C→再开，textarea/标题/状态全部是C

cases.title: Copy in-flight payload change
cases.expected: A复制pending切C，A完成不能给C写Link copied或旧manualURL

cases.title: Native cancel/fallback/focus
cases.expected: share成功resolve、取消、不可用、复制拒绝分别验；关闭回实际trigger

cases.title: Find cancels note
cases.expected: 音频播放中Find成功/非法/音域外输入都先cancel；不保留旧声音

cases.title: Print state follows current UI
cases.expected: 88 Print→afterprint→61/octaves off→Ctrl+P使用61/off；非法printPart不空白

cases.title: Round and review keyboard focus
cases.expected: Start→Question→Next→Results→Review→Back，键盘焦点有合理落点；原始分数不变

cases.title: Actual first-side failure
cases.expected: 真实owner平台/资源边界失败；第二段不触发，答案disabled，错误可重试

cases.title: Actual second-side failure
cases.expected: 第一段成功第二段失败，不能complete/解锁猜题

cases.title: Retry completeness
cases.expected: 清除失败后Retry必须等两段完成，完成事件只一次；无残留source/timer

cases.title: No production force-error branch
cases.expected: 生产实现不依赖window.__hearForceAudioError来模拟失败；测试不注入错误DOM

cases.title: Clean patch + new files
cases.expected: clean diff无stderr，所有新增B04路由/data/events/OG/viewport/assets都有manifest/内容

cases.title: Recoverability dry run
cases.expected: 从记录baseline+快照在临时目录恢复scope且hash匹配；不在live dirty tree尝试

cases.title: Raw evidence included
cases.expected: raw unit/browser JSON+logs+exit codes+截图索引在ZIP内可读取

cases.title: All preset targets enabled
cases.expected: 所有option/88/61完整10题target MIDI可点；黑键断言不接受任意自然音字母

cases.title: Backward compatible shared sequence
cases.expected: 现有v1 seed=20260916 natural-c4-c5题序不变且不含发送者分数/身份

cases.title: Full same-tree regressions
cases.expected: Practice、B04、Tools、Foundation/build/diff check同candidate，失败不藏

cases.title: Event transport reality
cases.expected: 确认事件owner/collector；本地事件不伪装真实流量采集

cases.title: iPhone share real targets
cases.expected: 真机原生面板打开/取消/发送，另一设备恢复当前payload

cases.title: Listening real hardware
cases.expected: 当前candidate听音/Stop/切pair/后台恢复，无旧声音与长时间失控

cases.title: Screen reader practical path
cases.expected: VoiceOver/NVDA完成基础流程与dialog，焦点/名称可用

cases.title: Print real output
cases.expected: 当前88/61设置与实体输出一致，黑白键/边界完整可读
